heading: Dinner
description: Dinner offers two seasonal kaiseki plan options.
Both plans use ingredients from around Lake Toya and Hokkaido, and are served warm so you can enjoy them at their best.
comparisonNote: If you want to enjoy the flavor of seafood and vegetables in a hot pot, we recommend the Yosenabe Kaiseki. If you prefer hearty meat dishes, the Omakase Japanese Kaiseki (shabu-shabu) is a great choice.

plans.name: Yosenabe Kaiseki
description: This plan focuses on a hearty hot pot made with abundant seafood and vegetables.
It is especially recommended in winter for warming you from the inside out.
plans.recommendedFor: Guests who prefer seafood and vegetable-forward dishes
plans.seasonalNote: The menu may vary depending on the season and availability.

plans.name: Omakase Japanese Kaiseki
description: This plan centers on shabu-shabu using premium pork shoulder loin, along with seasonal appetizers and grilled dishes.
Enjoy a rich and indulgent dish with a sweet-savory broth and egg.
plans.recommendedFor: Guests who want to enjoy meat dishes fully
plans.seasonalNote: The menu may vary depending on the season and availability.
